stem: At a well-child visit, which measurements should be assessed serially and plotted on the appropriate growth chart?

options.text: Weight, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation
Head circumference, abdominal girth, and temperature

explanation: Weight, height/length, and head circumference are the standard measurements to assess serially and plot on the appropriate growth chart.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 12

optionExplanations.A: Correct because weight, height/length, and head circumference are the key serial growth measurements plotted on paediatric growth charts.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because blood pressure and oxygen saturation are not part of the standard serial growth measurements.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because temperature and heart rate are vital signs, not the core growth parameters plotted serially.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because abdominal girth and temperature are not the routine measurements used for growth chart plotting.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because vision and hearing are developmental assessments, not serial growth measurements.
